edges.carries: the new monthly price Spotify states
the amount paid for the March Spotify payment
the shortfall amount and the payee, Spotify
the user's approval and the approved shortfall amount
the payment confirmation or the failure reason

nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the Spotify price increase notice to get the new monthly price

nodes.name: FindMarchPayment
nodes.role: find the March Spotify payment in the user's transaction history and get the amount paid

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: work out the difference between the new price and the amount paid for March

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the shortfall amount and payee and get their approval to pay

nodes.name: PaySpotify
nodes.role: pay the approved shortfall amount to Spotify

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the shortfall payment was sent and for how much
